newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Ericsson wins $52 mln Japanese order.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Ericsson wins $52 mln Japanese order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Thursday it had received a $52 million order from Kansai Digital Phone in Japan to expand its PDC mobile telephone system.
Ericsson said in a statement that the expansion will widen Kansai Digital Phone's coverage area and increase system capacity to meet the anticipated subscriber growth in the Osaka-Kobe-Kyoto region.
The order includes AXE switching and radio base station equipment as well as new services for subscribers and operators.
Ericsson said the capacity increase and the services will be available for use during the autumn of 1997.
